answer: Each epoch the island registry posts one fresh task: carry a sealed walnut across the river and plant it on the island. Each agent locks 70 credits and files a key-signed completion; an auditor replays it on the river log, and a copied record or reused walnut burns the bond. First task 38, k-th 38+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,534,500 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented crossing fails: one walnut, one key. An honest agent pays 38 once.
